Depressive episode? 2 weeks of depressed mood (most days) and meeting a sufficient number of depressive symptoms. If anyone is curious you can find the DSM5 criteria for depressions etc by googling. Mania - 1 week, hypomania - typically 4 days.

The response all to often is for the other person to assert that we CAN do the task (or set of tasks, etc). They don’t understand how much cognitive energy one task can take sometimes (which is often actually MANY mini tasks once broken down). We don’t do autopilot the same way.

Maybe you need to ease into it a bit more? Have you been unwell mentally/physically? Going back to Zumba while depressed made me feel like death. And we only get so many spoons some days. Perhaps your GP or another doctor can advise the best way for you to start exercising
